description: This file defines the CategoryRepository class responsible for database operations related to CategoryModel objects in a Flutter application. It includes methods to retrieve all categories and fetch a category by its ID.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing data access methods for CategoryModel objects, interfacing with a SQLite database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all category records from the database, ordered by name in ascending order.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a single CategoryModel by its ID; returns null if no such record exists.
